parts.value:
The set $Y-X$ is the set of all elements belonging to $Y$ but *not* $X.$ Note that the elements $1,3\in X$ are also in $Y,$ so we must remove them. Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}Y-X & =\{1,2,3,4\}-\{1,3,5,7\} \\  & =\{2,4\}.\end{aligned}
$$
